method: Static original UnityFS serialized objects via UnityPy plus supplied Il2CppDumper/WABT WAT. No original game execution and no Unity Editor actions. WAT comments identify method slot and actual function index. Observations below describe only supplied artifact.

strings.value: Keep working out to defeat stronger opponents!

observed_weight.recommended_formula: max(5, RoundToInt(min(300,RoundToInt((strength * float32.fromhex(0x1.42381ep-6) + 5f)/5f)*5f)/5f)*5); RoundToInt uses ties-to-even. strength key follows Chest/Arms/Back/Legs.
observed_weight.enter_workout: Resets progress; sets autoTraining=false; workingOut=true; curWeight=CalculateRecommendedWeight(); refreshes recommended and both weight labels.
observed_weight.change_weight: ChangeCurWeight(change) sets changedWeightSinceEnablingAutoTrain=true; ResetWorkoutBar(); curWeight=max(5,curWeight+change); UpdateWeightText(). No maximum weight clamp here.
observed_weight.recommended_click: ResetWorkoutBar(); curWeight=CalculateRecommendedWeight(); UpdateWeightText(); does not set changedWeightSinceEnablingAutoTrain.
observed_weight.display: weightText and _weightText both show decimal int immediately followed by kg. Recommended button shows recommended int followed by kg.
observed_weight.tip: recommendedWeightTip GO513 active iff curWeight < recommendedWeight, in UpdateWeightText and UpdateRecommendedText.
observed_weight.persistence: curWeight is not stored to PlayerPrefs in any extracted WorkingOutManager method; entering each workout sets it from recommendation.
observed_weight.plate_fields: plates[16] serialized all zero; backPlates,legPlates,armPlates,chestPlates each length16, only first two refs non-null; plateMaterials length9. Constructor allocates plates[16]. No accesses to these fields found in all WorkingOutManager method WAT bodies other than constructor storing plates. No demonstrated plate rebuild on ChangeCurWeight/UpdateWeightText.
observed_weight.weight_effect_boundary: Full WorkingOutManager.Update does not load this.curWeight. curWeight does not enter speed, completion threshold or strength payout in supplied original. Do not invent weight/strength difficulty or dynamic plate formula.

observed_workout.speed: Every working Update forces autoTraining=true. E keydown or pending holdingBTN sets speed=3.5 desktop (5 phone), consumes holdingBTN=false, flashes bar to yellow RGBA(1,1,0,1), plays next workoutArray audio with random pitch. Then speed=Lerp(speed,doubleAutoTrain?1.3:0.5,deltaTime*(phone?16:25)). workoutProgress=max(0,workoutProgress+speed*deltaTime). Animator currentType+Workout=true, WorkoutSpeed=speed. Image fill=workoutProgress; completion when >=0.99.
observed_workout.button: WorkoutButton(true) sets pending holdingBTN; false does nothing. PointerDown/Up supplied through EventTrigger, not Button.onClick. Therefore one pulse per press; holding does not generate continual pulses.
observed_workout.bar_color: Every working Update lerps bar color to RGBA(1,.75,.2,1) with factor deltaTime*7; activation pulse flashes RGBA(1,1,0,1).
observed_workout.history: Records (workoutSpeed,currentTime) every working frame; predicate func50053 removes entries older than 0.5 second; every 0.5 sec evaluates average speed.
observed_workout.muscle_colour: UpdateMuscleColour(image.fillAmount): t=Clamp01(abs(Clamp01(value)-.5)*2); color=Color.Lerp(redColor,skinColor,t); applies only current muscle if corresponding MuscleManager multiplier<1. Therefore skin at progress0/1, red at progress.5. ResetWorkoutBar resets all four muscle material colors to skinColor.
observed_workout.payout: At completion base per PrestigeLVL1..10=[11,13,15,20,24,28,33,38,43,48]; multiply by 1 + current muscle Modifier / 100f; truncate float to int. Current weight absent.
observed_workout.completion: CameraShake intensity=.08f duration=.14f; SpawnParticle(strengthGained); currentType+Workout=false; PlayerPrefs currentType+Strength += gain; play workoutParticles[particleIndex], next index=(index+1<3?index+1:0), despite serialized length4; LoadStats; ResetWorkoutBar; UpdateRecommendedText.
observed_workout.auto_weight: After completion autoTraining && !changedWeightSinceEnablingAutoTrain updates to new recommendation. Otherwise update if curWeight<recommended && autoTraining or OnPhone==1. Actual Update sets autoTraining=true unconditionally while working, which must be preserved when matching this artifact.
observed_workout.keyboard_split: Configured Keybind4 (original initialized Space in separate settings evidence) and Escape trigger ExitWorkout in Update lines155-180. Literal e via InputUnsafeUtility.GetKeyDownString triggers faster-workout pulse later. e is not GetString fallback.
observed_workout.speed_lifecycle: Ctor func50054 sets workoutSpeed=.3f (float bits1050253722). ResetWorkoutBar/EnterWorkout/ExitWorkout/ChangeCurWeight/ClickRecommendedButton do not write private speed offset356 (0x164). Reset progress and AnimatorFloat0 preserve speed/history. Pulse first sets3.5/5 then same frame still Lerp to doubleAutoTrain?1.3:.5. Pointer held does not continuously raise target; each true sets one pending pulse consumed once. Update samples previous speed to history before current-frame pulse/Lerp.

observed_tutorial.line_state0: CompletedTutorial default0: line position1=playerPos, position0=workoutStation; when ArmsStrength>=51 write CompletedTutorial=1 (line switches target on next Update).
observed_tutorial.line_state1: CompletedTutorial==1: line position1=playerPos, position0=fightZone. Other persisted values produce no line position update.
observed_tutorial.start_post_first_opponent: Tutorial.Start if CurOpponent>0: if KeepTrainingHint!=1 activate keepTrainingHint GO372 and write KeepTrainingHint=1; deactivate tutorialLine GO199; disable Tutorial component. Occurs at Start, not a demonstrated live CurOpponent watcher.
observed_tutorial.arms_workout_hints: CalculateRecommendedWeight when current type Arms and CurOpponent==0: disables tutorialLine GO199. ArmsStrength<=49 activates workoutTooltip GO3; ArmsStrength>=50 deactivates workoutTooltip then Invoke(ExitTooltip,.2f). ExitTooltip activates exitTooltip GO314. This side effect can be invoked repeatedly by recommendation and label refreshes.
observed_tutorial.workout_exit: ExitWorkout activates interactBTNHolder GO417; if CurOpponent==0 activates tutorialLine GO199. Deactivates workoutUI parent GO881; it does not directly reset the child workoutTooltip/exitTooltip activeSelf flags.
observed_tutorial.fight_menu_hint: FightMenu.OnEnable activates fightTooltip when CurOpponent==0. OnEnable also deactivates object at FightMenu+0x80; exact ref resolved separately.
observed_tutorial.gated_objects: TurnOffIfTutorial.Start disables own GO when CurOpponent<=0. Component present on Daily Rewards Button GO510, AutoTrain GO643, TrainerButton GO855. It uses first opponent completion, not CompletedTutorial.
observed_tutorial.post_fight_hint: KeepTrainingTip GO372 serialized inactive; text: Keep working out to defeat stronger opponents! Delete4652 serialized turnOffAfterTime=true,destroy=false,time=4.5,randomTime=false. Delete.OnEnable CancelInvoke(TurnOff), then Invoke(TurnOff,4.5); TurnOff sets GO active=false. Also contains TurnOffIfPhone4653. Animator3013 uses sharedassets0 controller383 KeepTrainingTip.
observed_tutorial.threshold_difference: Workout tooltip ends at50 but tutorial line target switches at51; preserve both thresholds.
observed_tutorial.no_invented_mask: Tutorial has no screen mask field. WorkoutTooltip and ExitTooltip are pointing image children. Fullscreen dim overlays must be traced to real serialized image/animation if used.

integration_suggestions.ownership: WeightStage owns scene-referenced weight labels/buttons, hint GOs, pulse/progress/speed; parent flow owns enter/exit and persistent stats. Native source behavior above supersedes any suggestions.
hooks: EnterWorkout(muscle,strength,curOpponent): reset, compute recommendation, set labels; tutorial line off for first Arms workout.
ChangeWeight(delta): reset repetition before applying ±5; minimum5, no upper cap.
ApplyRecommendedWeight(): reset repetition and assign recommendation.
PulseWorkout(): one pending pulse consumed next tick.
CompleteWorkout(): calculate gain with actual tier/base table; persist stat; reset; refresh recommended; auto-update selected weight under source condition.
TickTutorial(): use persisted CompletedTutorial and ArmsStrength>=51; line target original arms station or fightZone.
StartTutorial(): disable line/hide 3 native feature controls when CurOpponent<=0; one-time KeepTrainingHint when CurOpponent>0.
integration_suggestions.camera: ChestPressMachine.GetCameraPosition(level)=Vector3.Lerp(newCameraPos,newCameraPosLvl10,(Clamp(level,1,10)-1)/9f); these serialized station values and original stage transforms should be owned by scene stage, not UI runtime construction.
